PM Narendra Modi addresses IIT Delhi graduates, emphasizes importance of mentors and curiosity

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the 57th convocation ceremony of Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, inspiring graduates to welcome transformation and nurture their thirst for knowledge. He emphasized the importance of mentors and networks that support their journeys. Modi also highlighted the need for women in STEM fields.
